---
name: HA Mapping Reviewer
description: Test Home Assistant sensor mapping and automatic dashboard views.
---
Card editor allows manual mapping of 15 sensors and automatic prefix matching for unmapped telemetry. Manual mapping overrides automatic.
No configuration controls appear on either displayed screen.
Charging-state sensor automatically switches screens. Missing values display unavailable, never fabricated data.
Check safe entity IDs and HTML escaping, the full-screen presentation, and both desktop and phone Playwright tests.
Do not edit the separate XPENG backend integration or call unverified XPENG APIs.
